## Radio.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this radio selects. Must be unique within its group.
- `label` :: The label; in the `card` variant it is the card title.
- `description` :: Supporting text under the label, in a quieter ink.
- `children` :: Rich label content, used in place of `label`.
- `gap` :: The space between the dot and the label. @default 'gap-sm'

## RadioGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value of the selected radio. Two-way bindable; `undefined` means nothing is selected.
- `onValueChange` :: Called after the user picks a radio, with its value.
- `orientation` :: Lays the radios out in a column (`vertical`) or a wrapping row (`horizontal`).
- `name` :: The field name shared by every radio; it groups them natively and is submitted with a form. Generated when omitted.
- `variant` :: `default` is a radio dot beside a label; `card` is a selectable bordered card with a title and description.
- `size` :: The radio and text scale.
- `textSize` :: The text scale of every label, independent of the control. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `disabled` :: Disables every radio in the group.
- `invalid` :: Marks the group as failing validation.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of a card option. @default 'modern'
- `surface` :: The recipe behind a card option: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'elevated'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the description under a label, in both variants. @default 'text-sm'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the description under a label, in both variants. @default 'text-secondary'
- `gap` :: The space between options — between cards in the `card` variant, between rows otherwise. @default 'gap-sm' for cards, 'gap-md' otherwise
- `children` :: The `Radio` parts.

## radio-group.ts

### `interface RadioGroupState`

The state a `RadioGroup` shares with its `Radio` parts.

- `textSize` :: The text scale the group passes down.
- `childTextSize` :: The text scale of every description.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of every description.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of a card option.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind a card option.
